scorer: builder self-score (phase 1; the blind contract_review score supersedes it)
pre_mortem: The solver writes a reference from the standard and fuzzes. It fixes the rate's rounding by editing the shared rounding.divide in place and the drive/trailer removal depth by editing REMOVAL in place (cycle-1 solvers did both kinds of in-place edits). km_left and regroove are named only in the README and no rule settles them, so a reference written from the standard either omits them or recomputes them from the edited helpers, and self-testing agrees with the over-reach. It is right only if it notices that its edits reached two figures the standard never mentions.
decisive_reason: both traps are value-level: the items are governed, so a subject-membership check does not reveal them; risk is that a solver diffing the README keys against the standard spots km_left and regroove as silent.
